ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the lateral lobes. A dark, butterfly-shaped central region extends from the peduncle to the median notch. Distinct dark circular spots are located in the upper-outer quadrants of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude peaks and jagged valleys located on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; two primary dark circular spots located on the white fields of the distal lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant linear pixel disruptions present: cross-hatched diagonal marks on the medial-lower left lobe and a prominent dark, vertically-curved linear streak on the right lobe near the central pigmentation border.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonies at the outer fluke tips; multiple rake marks/scratches across the ventral surface indicative of past physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical placement of 'eye' spots in the distal white regions of both fluke lobes.
